name: getchatdata
title_zh: 16 件套聊天记录取证包，导出即带时间戳与元数据
tagline_zh: 聊天记录要当证据、做备份、喂给 AI？不用再逐条截图。这套件能按对话、按日期、按关键词拆包。
tagline_en: Need chat logs for evidence, backup, or AI training? Stop screenshotting. This kit splits by thread, date, or.
why_zh: 不是单个导出脚本，而是 16 个互相咬合的 skill：先清洗、再结构化、后分卷。
why_en: Not one script but 16 interlocking skills: clean, structure, then split. Every step keeps raw fields—no silent 'optimization.'.
limit_zh: 只认 WhatsApp、Telegram、微信的已导出文本或 HTML；不接数据库直连。图片、语音。
limit_en: Only parses exported text/HTML from WhatsApp, Telegram, WeChat. No DB access. Media files keep paths only—no downloads. Recalled messages become.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 16-skill chat export kit with timestamps & metadata
